svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The front is the long wall that will face you on the bench; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: antenna sits toward the back. Mark the front before cutting.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Vent slots: two slots 40 x 4 mm in each long wall, centred 32 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left of the middle, 2.5 to 6.5 and 9.5 to 13.5 mm above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside of the floor. Chain drill 3.5 mm and file to the line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front wall, 26 mm above the outside of the floor: a 20 mm hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50 mm right of the middle (network coupler) and a 16.2 mm hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm right of the middle (power gland). Step drill, light pressure.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: four 2.7 mm holes for the computer: 58 mm apart along the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: base and 49 mm apart across it, the left pair 59 mm and the right

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pair 1 mm left of the middle. Use the maker's bosses if it has them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tape the faces first; no solvents; deburr inside and out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the computer on the floor; its holes line up with yours.
